title: A manager ends an unattended headless runner whose report is written and whose process stays, with one command instead of a hand-written monitor script
goal: backlog.py runner watch --pid PID --report FILE --stale SECONDS ends with SIGTERM a process whose command line names claude when its report file is older than the bound while the process lives and then exits 0; it exits 0 without signalling when the process ends by itself; it refuses a pid whose command line does not name claude, signalling nothing (exit 2)

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P
d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());rep=d/"report.md";mark=d/"termed";fake=d/"claude_fake.py"
fake.write_text("import signal,sys,time,pathlib as P\nrep,mark,life=sys.argv[1:4]\nsignal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,lambda *a:(P.Path(mark).write_text('t'),sys.exit(0)))\nP.Path(rep).write_text('done')\ntime.sleep(float(life))\n")
def start(life):return s.Popen([sys.executable,str(fake),str(rep),str(mark),str(life)])
def watch(pid,stale,t=90):return s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","runner","watch","--pid",str(pid),"--report",str(rep),"--stale",str(stale)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=t)

p=start(120);time.sleep(2)
w=watch(p.pid,1)
try:p.wait(timeout=10);dead=True
except s.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();dead=False
print(w.returncode,dead,mark.exists(),w.stdout[-150:],w.stderr[-150:])
sys.exit(0 if w.returncode==0 and dead and mark.exists() else 1)

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: 159 Monitor tool calls in the orchestrating sessions, each a hand-written script (96 'tail -F chain.log | grep ... & while true; do r=...report.md; if [ -f $r ] && [ $(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m $r) )) -gt 600 ] && pgrep -f "kb-sprint run SP-..."; then echo HUNG', 35 'L=<scratch>...'; median 567 characters of shell) and 76 ScheduleWakeup calls (median 1800 s). The hang is a known case: a runner writes its report and its process stays, the manager's notes call for a watchdog and a SIGTERM of the own pid; no tool does it (backlog.py find watchdog, headless and runner found no item). Low confidence and manager-only: the turns are in the wait story; the hang case costs hours. The command name and flags are a proposal; the planted check ends a planted sleeping process. Also wanted: a start form that launches a runner with a fixed session id and its brief on stdin and prints the pid. Lane: parked sprint-orchestration class, EP-gzr4mmkm. Planning 2026-10-24: the planted runners are python processes whose command line names claude (the first draft's check ended a plain sleep); the guard keeps the command from signalling any other process. The command waits, so a manager starts it as a background command.
